plan.objective: Make account search match on email address as well as name
expectedSchemas: account object shape: { name: string, email?: string }
plan.intent: Add email-address matching to the existing case-insensitive substring account search, so a query matches when it is contained in either the account name or the account email; existing name matching and the empty/whitespace-query rejection are preserved, and accounts lacking an email field must not throw.

plan.objective: Round every amount a customer is shown to whole pence so totals never display long decimals
plan.intent: Change the customer-facing rounding precision in src/format/money.js from whole pounds (PLACES = 0) to whole pence (PLACES = 2), so roundMoney and formatMoney — and orderTotal, which already routes through roundMoney — emit two-decimal amounts; add whole-pence assertions to test/money.test.js. No new modules, APIs, or dependencies; no other module's source or tests change.

plan.objective: Record the originating IP address on every audit entry
expectedSchemas: audit entry object: { actor, action, subject, ip }
plan.intent: Add a new originating-IP field to audit entries: extend auditEntry with an ip parameter and include ip on every returned entry object, plus test coverage asserting it; no existing fields, behavior, or the isPrivileged helper are removed or changed.

plan.objective: Add a created-at column to the CSV export
plan.intent: Adding behavior: append a new createdAt column to the CSV export column list and header, keeping the existing id, name and status columns and their order unchanged; no columns removed or disabled.

plan.objective: Retry webhook delivery up to three times when the transport reports a failure
expectedApis: deliver(subscriber, event, transport) -> { url, delivered, attempts }
expectedSchemas: webhook delivery result object: { url: string, delivered: boolean, attempts: number }
plan.intent: Add bounded retry behavior to the existing webhook deliver() function: re-invoke the injected transport when it reports failure (response.ok !== true), for a maximum of three total attempts, returning as soon as an attempt succeeds. This adds behavior only — no existing symbol, export, or module is removed, and the successful-delivery result contract is preserved apart from an added attempts count.

plan.objective: Orders paid by card should cost an extra five percent on top of what the customer would otherwise pay
expectedSchemas: order.payment (new optional field on the order object read by pricing; string payment method where "card" triggers the surcharge)
plan.intent: Add a new card-payment surcharge to order pricing: introduce src/pricing/surcharge.js exposing surchargeRate(order) returning 0.05 when the order is paid by card and 0 otherwise, and multiply the existing post-discount, post-delivery, post-tax amount in orderTotal by (1 + surchargeRate(order)) before roundMoney, so card orders cost five percent more than the amount otherwise payable while non-card orders are unchanged. No existing behavior is removed or disabled; no new dependencies, config, or services.

plan.objective: Add a flat two pound handling charge to every order's total
plan.intent: Add new behavior: introduce a flat £2 handling charge constant in src/pricing/total.js and include it in every orderTotal computation alongside the existing £3 delivery charge (added to the discounted line subtotal before tax is applied, so it is taxed like delivery), plus a test in test/total.test.js asserting the £2 increase. No existing behavior is removed or disabled; discount, tax, and rounding logic stay unchanged, and no other module is touched.

plan.objective: Orders that contain only digital goods should not be charged tax
expectedSchemas: order.lines[].digital (boolean flag marking a line item as a digital good; absent/falsey means physical)
expectedTests: test/tax.test.js::digital-only order is not charged tax
test/tax.test.js::mixed digital and physical order is still charged tax
test/tax.test.js::tax is charged on a standard order
plan.intent: Add a conditional tax exemption in taxFor: when every line of the order is a digital good, return 0 tax instead of the standard 20% rate; tax behavior for physical-only and mixed orders is unchanged. taxFor already receives the order argument (currently voided) and total.js already forwards it, so no caller or signature changes are needed; the digital marker is a new per-line boolean on the order shape. Tests are added only to test/tax.test.js, per the README rule that a module change must not touch another module's tests.

plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
plan.intent: Add a free-delivery threshold to order pricing: in src/pricing/total.js, replace the unconditional flat DELIVERY = 3 charge with a conditional charge that is 0 when the order's goods amount (line total after applying discountRate) is at least 100, and remains 3 otherwise; add tests in test/total.test.js covering just below, exactly at, and above the 100 threshold. No other module, API surface, schema, config key, or service changes; discount.js, tax.js, and format/money.js are reused unchanged and rounding still happens once at the end via roundMoney.

plan.objective: Customers who have placed more than twenty five orders should get fifteen percent off instead of ten
plan.intent: Modify existing loyalty-discount behavior: change the LOYAL_ORDERS threshold constant from 10 to 25 and the LOYAL_RATE constant from 0.1 to 0.15 in src/pricing/discount.js, so discountRate returns 0.15 only above 25 orders and 0 at or below it; extend test/discount.test.js to assert the new rate and the new boundary (25 -> 0, 26 -> 0.15). No new modules, APIs, config keys, or services are added and none are removed; orderTotal in src/pricing/total.js consumes discountRate unchanged.
